name: Makoto Naegi
description: An ordinary, optimistic student chosen by lottery to attend Hope's Peak Academy. His resilience becomes central to the first killing game.
story: Makoto enters Hope's Peak Academy and wakes to find himself trapped with his classmates. He relies on cooperation and deduction to uncover the truth.

name: Kyoko Kirigiri
description: A calm, observant detective who investigates the academy's secrets while keeping much of her own past hidden.
story: Kyoko carefully gathers evidence and helps guide investigations through the first killing game.

name: Byakuya Togami
description: An arrogant heir who treats the killing game as a contest of intellect and power.
story: Byakuya approaches the mysteries with ruthless pragmatism and gradually becomes an important presence in class trials.

name: Toko Fukawa
description: A socially anxious novelist with a sharp tongue and a complicated relationship with other people.
story: Toko survives the first killing game and later returns as one of the two playable leads in Ultra Despair Girls.

name: Sayaka Maizono
description: A famous idol who tries to maintain a friendly, composed image despite the fear around her.
story: Sayaka's time in the academy becomes part of the first case that teaches the students how dangerous the killing game is.

name: Mukuro Ikusaba
description: A soldier whose identity and role are tied to the larger mystery of Hope's Peak Academy.
story: Mukuro is connected to the hidden history behind the academy and the killing game.

name: Hajime Hinata
description: A student who arrives on Jabberwock Island with questions about his talent and his own memories.
story: A school trip quickly becomes another killing game, and Hajime must investigate the island while searching for the truth about himself.

name: Chiaki Nanami
description: A gentle, sleepy gamer who often offers calm, thoughtful observations.
story: Chiaki supports her classmates through investigations and trials while the mysteries of the island deepen.

name: Nagito Komaeda
description: An unpredictable student whose extreme beliefs about hope make him difficult to read.
story: Nagito's actions repeatedly change the direction of the island's killing game and its investigations.

name: Fuyuhiko Kuzuryu
description: A short-tempered heir to a powerful yakuza family who initially keeps others at a distance.
story: Fuyuhiko's role in the group changes as the students face the consequences of the killing game.

name: Sonia Nevermind
description: A curious, polite princess with a strong interest in unusual cultures and mysteries.
story: Sonia contributes knowledge and observations as the class investigates incidents around Jabberwock Island.

name: Ibuki Mioda
description: An energetic musician whose expressive personality brings chaotic enthusiasm to the group.
story: Ibuki joins the island's students as they try to make sense of the escalating events.

name: Komaru Naegi
description: Makoto's younger sister, who has been held captive before finding herself caught in Towa City's crisis.
story: Komaru teams up with Toko and uses a special hacking gun to survive a city controlled by hostile Monokumas.

name: Toko Fukawa
description: A survivor of the first killing game who accompanies Komaru and can transform into her alter ego, Genocide Jack.
story: Toko guides and protects Komaru through Towa City while confronting her own fears and relationships.

name: Monaca Towa
description: A seemingly sweet child who is one of the central figures among the Warriors of Hope.
story: Monaca's leadership connects the children's uprising to the wider despair crisis in Towa City.

name: Nagisa Shingetsu
description: A serious, calculating child who values planning and control.
story: Nagisa's actions are shaped by the Warriors of Hope's goal of creating a world without adults.

name: Jataro Kemuri
description: A withdrawn child who hides his face behind a mask and struggles with how others see him.
story: Jataro is one of the children Komaru and Toko encounter while crossing Towa City.

name: Masaru Daimon
description: An energetic child who presents himself as a heroic leader.
story: Masaru is part of the Warriors of Hope and their campaign against the adults of Towa City.

name: Shuichi Saihara
description: A reserved young detective whose confidence is tested by a new killing game.
story: Shuichi investigates the academy's cases alongside his classmates and becomes central to the search for the truth.

name: Kaede Akamatsu
description: An energetic pianist who tries to keep her classmates united and hopeful.
story: Kaede takes an active role in the group's early attempts to find a way out of the academy.

name: Maki Harukawa
description: A guarded, blunt student who initially appears uninterested in making friends.
story: Maki's past and abilities become increasingly important as the killing game progresses.

name: Kokichi Oma
description: A playful, manipulative student whose constant lies make his intentions difficult to determine.
story: Kokichi repeatedly disrupts the group's assumptions and changes how they approach the killing game.

name: Kaito Momota
description: A bold, encouraging student who tries to inspire others to face danger together.
story: Kaito becomes a source of motivation for Shuichi and other classmates during their investigations.

name: Maki Harukawa
description: A reserved student with a hidden background that complicates her quiet exterior.
story: Maki's story gradually reveals more about her identity and the choices she faces.
